title: MongoDB vs Firebase: Unveiling the Best Database Choice
description: The article provides a comprehensive comparison between MongoDB and Firebase, two popular database choices for applications. It discusses their features, including data model, querying, scalability, real-time updates, and security, as well as their cost structures, concluding that the choice depends on specific needs such as rich querying and scalability (MongoDB) or real-time updates and automatic scalability (Firebase).

title: Parquet vs Delta: Which Format Fits Your Data Needs?
description: Parquet is a columnar file format optimized for read-heavy analytical workloads, whereas Delta builds on Parquet, adding features like ACID transactions, schema enforcement, and time travel for mixed read/write operations. Choosing between them depends on your data pipeline's need for consistency, updates, and performance optimization.
